title: Electroporation of Oxyrrhis marina
author: Yutaka Hanawa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vcne2ve

steps.title: Prepare initial culture
steps.instruction: Transfer Oxyrrhis marina (NIES‑494) cells to 20 mL fresh IMK medium (Nihon Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.) in a 75 cm² plastic flask (IWAKI) at 200 cells/mL, add Pyramimonas parkeae (NIES‑254) feed at 1×10⁴ cells/mL, and incubate at 22 °C with a 14 h light/8 h dark cycle for 14 days; the culture should reach ~1×10⁴ cells/mL.

substeps.instruction: Transfer O. marina cells to 20 mL fresh IMK medium (200 cells/mL).
Add P. parkeae feed at 1×10⁴ cells/mL.
Incubate at 22 °C, 14 h light/8 h dark for 14 days.

steps.title: Concentrate and pre‑incubate culture
steps.instruction: Collect O. marina and P. parkeae from the 20 mL culture by centrifugation at 1,500 g for 4 min (swing rotor), resuspend the pellet in 2 mL fresh IMK medium, transfer the suspension to a 12‑well plastic plate, and incubate in darkness at 22 °C for 4 days; O. marina density should increase from 1×10⁵ to 5×10⁵ cells/mL while P. parkeae declines.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture at 1,500 g for 4 min (swing rotor).
Resuspend cell pellet in 2 mL fresh IMK medium.
Transfer suspension to a 12‑well plastic plate.
Incubate in dark at 22 °C for 4 days.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Harvest O. marina cells by centrifugation at 1,500 g for 4 min (swing rotor), resuspend the pellet in 100 µL Gene Pulser electroporation buffer (Bio‑Rad #1652676) to obtain 1×10⁶–5×10⁶ cells/mL, add DNA (5–25 µg) or RNA (5 µg), transfer the mixture to a 0.2 cm cuvette (Bio‑Rad), electroporate, immediately add 1.9 mL fresh IMK medium to the cuvette, and transfer the cells to a 12‑well plastic plate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 1,500 g for 4 min (swing rotor).
Resuspend pellet in 100 µL Gene Pulser electroporation buffer (final 1×10⁶–5×10⁶ cells/mL).
Add DNA (5–25 µg) or RNA (5 µg).
Transfer to a 0.2 cm electroporation cuvette (Bio‑Rad).
Electroporate (parameters as used by the lab).
Immediately add 1.9 mL fresh IMK medium to the cuvette.
Transfer cells to a 12‑well plastic plate.
